frontend.description: Generates Next.js frontend code (pages, components, hooks, lib, services) with Tailwind CSS, TypeScript strict mode, and Jest + React Testing Library tests.

nodejs.description: Generates Node.js backend code (Fastify routes, controllers, services, middleware, validators) with TypeScript, JWT auth, and Jest tests.

mongodb.description: Generates and manages the database layer (Prisma schema, seeds, data-access helpers) for MongoDB, with Jest tests.

security-audit-agent.description: Scans the Incident Report System codebase against OWASP Top 10 2026 for security vulnerabilities — auth bypass, XSS, broken access control, credential leakage, injection, supply chain, error handling, and regression against the golden rules in memory.md. Use before any release or after any auth-related changes.
